items.title: NextEra Energy (NEE) Draws Fresh Virginia Questions Over Merger Consumer Protections
items.summary: NextEra Energy (NYSE:NEE) faces fresh scrutiny as Virginia's Consumer Counsel flags ongoing gaps in the merger case with Dominion Energy. The Consumer Counsel's latest regulatory filing questions the completeness of merger data on competitive effects, rate impacts, and consumer safeguards. Regulators in Virginia are being asked to examine alleged filing errors, unclear market impact assumptions, and the enforceability of promised protections for customers.
